---
goal: "Add user profile avatar upload"
type: greenfield
max_iterations: 10
constraints:
  - "Images must be under 2MB"
  - "Only JPEG and PNG formats"
  - "No breaking changes to user API"
---

# Task: verify_upload_size_limit
risk: 0.9

Try to upload files larger than 2MB.
The upload should be rejected with a clear error message.
If you can upload a 5MB file successfully, this task is falsified.

# Task: verify_format_validation
risk: 0.8

Try to upload non-JPEG/PNG files (SVG, GIF, WebP, BMP).
Every non-allowed format should be rejected.
If any non-allowed format gets through, this task is falsified.

# Task: verify_api_compatibility
risk: 0.6
depends_on: [verify_upload_size_limit, verify_format_validation]

Verify that existing user API endpoints still work exactly as before.
Try to break any existing endpoint with the new avatar field present.
